name: Felt That: Boxing
detailed_description:
Summer Games Fest World Premiere

Felt That: Boxing joins Summer Game Fest 2025's highly curated keynote lineup of groundbreaking games. The annual showcase, which attracts millions of viewers globally, serves as the kickoff to gaming's biggest season and has become synonymous with the most exciting reveals in the industry.

Felt That: Boxing's world premiere trailer debuted during the main presentation, streaming live at and major platforms worldwide. The reaction was electric and overwhelmingly positive with host Geoff Keighley pronouncing "gotta wishlist that one!"


About the Game

Felt That: Boxing is a heartfelt and hilarious boxing game where the charm of furry puppets meets the fury of arcade fighting. Step into the shoes of Ezra “Fuzz-E” Wright, an unadoptable orphan turned prizefighter, as he throws down in the “Tournament of a Million Punches” to save his beloved puppet orphanage from ruthless demolition.

A Hero Made of Felt, with a Whole Lot of Heart

Fuzz-E never meant to follow in his belated father’s footsteps into the ring. But when a greedy developer threatens to bulldoze the only home he’s ever known, he laces up his oversized gloves and steps into the spotlight. What starts as a desperate bid to save the orphanage quickly escalates into a wild ride through bombastic arenas full of outrageous characters, ridiculous power-ups, and surprisingly emotional turns.

Developed by Sans Strings Studio in collaboration with Stoopid Buddy Stoodios.

---

Gameplay and Mechanics:

Felt That: Boxing blends tactile, physics-driven combat with responsive controls for a satisfying, skill-based brawling experience. Players train, punch, dodge, block, and flail their way through a series of increasingly elaborate arenas. Your first bouts may take place in an after-hours illegal cockfighting ring, but in success prepare to pack some stadiums!

*Arcade-Style Brawling – Fast-paced fights that reward timing, precision, and a little bit of chaos.

*Training Mini Games –  Even plunging toilets and dodging burnt toast can unlock secret moves for upcoming bouts.

*In-Stitches Super Moves – Absurd finishing attacks like Furry Flurry and Poopet Blaster.

*Chaos Mode – Like shaking a ragdoll, unleash a flurry of flailing puppet punches.

---

Modes and Replayability:

*Story Mode (approx. 8–12 hours) – Take agency over Fuzz-E’s heartfelt journey across a tournament bracket filled with eccentric opponents, each with unique arenas, mechanics, and story arcs.

*Trainer Challenges – Build the skills to win through off-the-wall training games like beating meat (the frozen kind), doing sweet splits, and trying to dissect a puppet frog (with gloves on).

*Unlockables and Flair – Including hand-designed costumes, costume hype music for entering the ring, and special taunts and dances.

---

Characters & Progression:

*Face off against challengers like Lumberjack Larry, Magic Mikey, Sid “Greed” Bankman, each with their own mechanics and hazardous arenas.

*As Fuzz-E, you'll gain confidence and skills by teaming up with the legendary trainer, Stinky “Winky” Bootstrap. Unlock new fight animations, gear, and super moves.

*Costumes, color palettes, and your personal stakes evolve as you rise through the ranks.

---

Visuals and Aesthetic:

*Inspired by real-world puppet-making, the game’s visual style mixes handcrafted charm with slick modern animation.

*It’s like your favorite retro punch game infused with furry life-like flailing puppets!

*Delightful visual gags, in-fight audience reactions, slow-mo replays and highlights keep things visually fresh and fun.

---

Soundtrack and Audio:

*Music by Grammy-winning artist, Flying Lotus.

*Dynamic soundtrack evolves as fights and training escalate.

*Voiceovers from a star-studded cast with improv-infused delivery to bring to life the comedy and drama.

---

 Why You'll Love It:

*Perfect for casual players wanting a fun single-player experience and players who love personality-packed indies.

*Bursting with humor and puppet soul. This isn’t just another smash ‘em up fighter.

*Combines the amazing tech and artistry of Sans Strings Studio and the irreverent humor and storytelling of Stoopid Buddy Stoodios.

*There’s heart behind them punches!

---

Will Fuzz-E go from underdog to unstoppable? Or will the orphanage become a parking lot? Punch your way to justice, stitch by stitch!

“Save us Fuzz-E… or we’ll die” - Adorable Puppet Orphan #2

Step into the shoes of Ezra "Fuzz-E" Wright, an unlikely hero with a big heart. His quest? Battle his way through the Tournament of a Million Punches to save an orphanage!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4790K or AMD Ryzen 5 1500x
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 470
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 6600XT
  • Storage: 100 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains stylized violence in the form of cartoonish boxing matches. It includes some mild to moderate profanity and explores adult themes such as death and abandonment through a darkly comedic lens. Sensitive topics like adoption and orphanage life are presented with satirical humor that may not be suitable for all players. While there is no sexual content or graphic depictions of violence, the tone and subject matter may be considered mature.
